description: Better Discord enhances Discord desktop app with new features.

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update and fix Crowdin setup by @zerebos in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2290
* update contributing for bun and typescript by @zerebos in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2292
* Feature (React Error Translations) by @zrodevkaan in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2295
* Fix wrong safe Storage in Discord by @domi-btnr in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2293
* Fix for upcoming rspack change by @doggybootsy in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2296
* New Crowdin Translations by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2298
* fix bd modal padding by @KingGamingYT in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2299
* Fix and bump by @doggybootsy in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2306
* Bump main to 1.14.5 by @doggybootsy in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2307

## New Contributors
* @github-actions[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/pull/2298

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/BetterDiscord/BetterDiscord/compare/v1.14.4...v1.14.5

hot_issues.title: [Feature] Allow users to modify enabled plugins on crash screen
[Feature] Prevent Discord from knowing that you're using a client mod
[Feature] Expose a way to add custom global keybinds from within a plugin

The only limit to the customization is your own imagination. [![Theme Split](https://betterdiscord.app/resources/branding/split.png)](https://betterdiscord.app/)
# Installation Download the installer for your operating system below. You can check [this page](https://docs.betterdiscord.app/users/getting-started/installation) for a more detailed guide. [![Windows Installer][windows-badge]][windows-link] [![Mac Installer][mac-badge]][mac-link] [![Linux Installer][linux-badge]][linux-link] [windows-link]: https://github.com/BetterDiscord/Installer/releases/latest/download/BetterDiscord-Installer-Windows.exe [windows-badge]: https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows%20(7+)-3a71c1?logo=Windows&logoColor=3a71c1&labelColor=0c0d10&color=3a71c1&style=for-the-badge [mac-link]: https://github.com/BetterDiscord/Installer/releases/latest/download/BetterDiscord-Installer-Mac.zip [mac-badge]: https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS%20(10.10+)-3a71c1?logo=Apple&logoColor=3a71c1&labelColor=0c0d10&color=3a71c1&style=for-the-badge [linux-link]: https://github.com/BetterDiscord/Installer/releases/latest/download/BetterDiscord-Installer-Linux.AppImage.zip [linux-badge]: https://img.shields.io/badge/Linux-3a71c1?logo=Linux&logoColor=3a71c1&labelColor=0c0d10&color=3a71c1&style=for-the-badge # Manual Installation For normal users, installing via the installers makes the most sense. However when wanting to either develop BetterDiscord, or when the installers do not work, this option can be used. Please see our [detailed documentation](https://docs.betterdiscord.app/users/getting-started/installation#manual-installation) for a guide on how to do this. # Addons Installing addons--like plugins and themes--is easy. All you need to do is select and download an addon from [our website][website-link] and put it in your folder. If you want some more details, or just prefer a visual guide, take a look at our [tutorial on installing addons](https://docs.betterdiscord.app/users/guides/installing-addons) that includes a demonstration video. # Platform Support BetterDiscord currently only supports standard local Discord installs. This means snap packages, portable apps, and the web version are all not supported. Examples of supported platforms: - Windows 7 and newer - macOS Yosemite and newer - Ubuntu 14.04 and newer # Contributors For information on contributing to this project, please see [CONTRIBUTING.md](/CONTRIBUTING.md).
